answer: Each agent stakes a bonded transponder key whose rendezvous history is hashed into a shared ledger, so duplicate identities cannot occupy the same orbital slot without colliding on the yarrow-marked knoll of verified tracklets. Colluders attempting to flood the proximity graph with phantom dockers must cross-reference every claim against the river of signed burn telemetry. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
